---
title: "Publications"
format: html
---

::: {#pub-updated .small .text-muted}
:::

::: {#pub-sections}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
async function loadPublications() {
  const sectionsEl = document.getElementById("pub-sections");
  const updatedEl = document.getElementById("pub-updated");

  // Type -> section heading / icon. Anything not listed falls into "other".
  const TYPE_META = {
    "journal-article": { label: "Peer-Reviewed Publications", icon: "bi-journal-check" },
    "preprint":        { label: "Preprints",                  icon: "bi-file-earmark-text" },
    "other":           { label: "Other",                      icon: "bi-bookmark" },
  };
  const TYPE_ORDER = ["journal-article", "preprint", "other"];

  try {
    // Works when _data is published with site output.
    const res = await fetch("/_data/publications.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();

    const items = data.items || [];
    if (data.updated_at) {
      const dt = new Date(data.updated_at);
      updatedEl.textContent = `Last updated: ${dt.toLocaleString()}`;
    }

    if (!items.length) {
      sectionsEl.innerHTML = "<p>No publications found.</p>";
      return;
    }

    // Group by type, preserving each item's existing (year-descending) order.
    const groups = {};
    items.forEach((p) => {
      const key = TYPE_ORDER.includes(p.type) ? p.type : "other";
      (groups[key] = groups[key] || []).push(p);
    });

    TYPE_ORDER.forEach((key) => {
      const groupItems = groups[key];
      if (!groupItems || !groupItems.length) return;

      const meta = TYPE_META[key];

      const section = document.createElement("section");
      section.className = "pub-section";

      const heading = document.createElement("h2");
      heading.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${meta.icon} me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>${meta.label}`;
      section.appendChild(heading);

      const list = document.createElement("div");
      list.className = "pub-cards";

      groupItems.forEach((p) => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "pub-card";

        const authors = (p.authors || []).join(", ");
        const year = p.year ? ` (${p.year}).` : ".";
        const journal = p.journal ? ` <em>${p.journal}</em>.` : "";

        const buttons = [];
        if (p.doi_url) {
          buttons.push(
            `<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="${p.doi_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
               <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>DOI
             </a>`
          );
        }
        if (p.url && p.url !== p.doi_url) {
          buttons.push(
            `<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="${p.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
               <i class="bi bi-link-45deg me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>Link
             </a>`
          );
        }

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="pub-icon"><i class="bi ${meta.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>
          <div class="pub-body">
            <div class="pub-title">${p.title ?? "Untitled"}</div>
            <div class="pub-meta">${authors}${year}${journal}</div>
            ${buttons.length ? `<div class="pub-buttons">${buttons.join("")}</div>` : ""}
          </div>
        `;
        list.appendChild(card);
      });

      section.appendChild(list);
      sectionsEl.appendChild(section);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    sectionsEl.innerHTML = `<p>Could not load publications data.</p>`;
    console.error(err);
  }
}

loadPublications();
</script>
```
